services.title: Housekeeping
services.short: Daily upkeep that holds its standard on the three-hundredth day, not just the first.
services.description: Trained, uniformed housekeeping teams working to a written scope for your building — floors, restrooms, workstations, common areas, glass and waste. Each site gets a cleaning schedule matched to its footfall, a checklist the supervisor signs, and a named person accountable for the result.
services.alt: Apex housekeeping team member cleaning a modern corporate workspace
applications: Periodic deep cleaning and floor restoration

services.title: Security
services.short: Uniformed, briefed and posted to a written duty chart — not just present, but accountable.
services.description: Manned guarding with documented post instructions for every position. Access control, visitor handling, gate and material movement records, patrol rounds and shift handover in writing. Supervisors check posts through the shift rather than only at the start of it.
services.alt: Apex security professional at a corporate building entrance

services.title: Technical maintenance
services.short: Planned work that stops breakdowns being the only time anyone looks at the plant.
services.description: Electrical, plumbing, HVAC and general upkeep run on a planned preventive schedule rather than a call-out queue. Meter readings, filter changes, pump checks and DG runs recorded against a calendar, with breakdown response and escalation defined before anything fails.
services.alt: Apex maintenance technician inspecting building services plant
applications: Electrical panels, lighting and DG sets

services.title: Landscaping
services.short: The first thing a visitor sees, maintained on a schedule instead of on request.
services.description: Lawn care, pruning, seasonal planting, irrigation checks and indoor plant upkeep. Grounds are worked to a maintenance calendar so a campus looks the same in the week before an audit as it does in the week after one.
services.alt: Apex landscaping professional maintaining a corporate campus lawn
applications: Tree pruning and green waste removal

services.title: Pest management
services.short: Scheduled, documented treatment — with a record you can produce during an audit.
services.description: Treatment programmes for cockroaches, rodents, termites and mosquitoes using approved chemicals, applied on a schedule and logged. Every visit produces a service record showing what was treated, with what, where and by whom.
services.alt: Apex pest management technician carrying out a documented treatment

services.title: Manpower and support
services.short: Front office, pantry, helpdesk and general support staff, deployed and supervised.
services.description: Trained support roles placed on site and managed by Apex — front office, pantry and cafeteria support, helpdesk, mailroom, office assistants and general operatives. Attendance, replacement cover and statutory paperwork are handled by us, not by your admin team.
services.alt: Apex support staff at a shift briefing before deployment
